label: The cost of one net
subgoals: Find the minimum and maximum x and y of the terminals
Count the channels spanned in each direction

label: The q(n) correction
subgoals: Read q(n) for each net's terminal count
Multiply each net's span sum by its q(n)

label: Incremental cost of a move
subgoals: Collect only the nets on the moved block
Recompute each net's cost before and after the move
Sum the differences to get the change in cost
